requirements_summary: Latency-sensitive recommendation engine + short-chat assistant. P95 target <= 50ms for 64-token prompts; sustained throughput 150-250 rps; peak bursts up to 600 rps for 15s. Cost sensitivity: aim to reduce per-token TCO by 60-70% vs current hosted baseline. Model preference: open LLM (Llama-3-style) with quantization to int8/int4, fallback to FP16 for rare heavy-context requests. Need KV/prefix caching per user, deterministic routing, and the ability to pin model versions for rollouts.
